messages:
emily: Quick q — for the new audit pipeline what's the delivery window to S3/SIEM and what fields get redacted? e.g. do we hash user ids or strip emails? Prepping an integration ticket. cc @samir @jordan
samir: short answer: near-real-time to our internal S3 (1–2m typical, up to ~10m). Customer SIEM connector is batched (5m) or could be streaming (if enabled). For external exports we HMAC user_id per-tenant and redact emails unless customer opts in.
emily: Do we have a sample schema or mapping I can point to? Also what's the retention on exported files (customer-side and our S3 backups)?
samir: Pasting minimal snippet and rules:
```
# audit_event schema (trimmed)
- timestamp
- actor_user_id -> export: HMAC_SHA256(tenant_key, user_id)
- actor_email -> export: "[REDACTED]" unless allow_email_export=true
- action
- resource
- ip_address -> export: truncate_last_octet
- raw_payload -> internal only
```
Retention: internal raw logs kept 90d; exported files retained per-customer export settings (default 30d), we mirror exports to backup-bucket for 7d.
jordan: ops caveat: if pipeline backlog > 1M events we switch heavy-load mode and roll exports into hourly bulks; rare but worth flagging for large-migrations.
emily: who signs off on one-off ad-hoc exports (support/dev requests)? need to document in the integration ticket.
samir: Support/dev ad-hoc exports require security + product-ops approval. Use the internal /request-export flow (creates an audit ticket). Exports are scoped queries only, TTL 24h, and result files are stored encrypted with access logging.
security-bot: export request #EXP-987 created by emily — awaiting approval from @samir
samir: I'll review after you post the ticket. include exact query, intended recipients, and requested retention TTL.
emily: will do, adding the sample query + this schema link to the ticket. thanks!
jordan: 👍
